June, Gideon's 1 Jul post in #strategic-pod says he closed out **ticket #8841** with support that morning. The fix was that Vantorre's IT cleared a **browser cache issue on the kiosk tablets**, after which the standard Detention Summary template worked for their billing team.

Some of the older summary notes describe #8841 differently, as a kiosk timeout or a Door 14 selection problem, so the channel post is the better record for what was closed that day.
